description: This file defines a jscolor object implementing a color picker widget with functions for color manipulation, event handling, and UI rendering, including URI parsing and cross-browser support.

classes.name: jscolor
classes.description: An object encapsulating color picker functionality, including color conversions, UI rendering, and event handling.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Initializes the jscolor object and sets up event bindings.

methods.name: addEvent
methods.description: Adds an event listener to an element, supporting both modern and older IE models.

methods.name: requireImage
methods.description: Registers an image filename to be loaded for the color picker UI.

methods.name: loadImage
methods.description: Loads an image resource if not already loaded.

methods.name: fetchElement
methods.description: Retrieves a DOM element by ID or returns the element if already provided.

methods.name: fireEvent
methods.description: Dispatches a DOM event on an element, supporting different event models.

methods.name: getElementPos
methods.description: Calculates the position of an element relative to the document.

methods.name: getElementSize
methods.description: Returns the width and height of an element.

methods.name: getRelMousePos
methods.description: Gets the mouse position relative to an element.

methods.name: getViewPos
methods.description: Returns the current scroll position of the viewport.

methods.name: getViewSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the viewport.

methods.name: URI
methods.description: A constructor for parsing and manipulating URIs according to RFC 3986.

methods.name: color
methods.description: Constructor for a color object managing color state, conversions, and UI interactions.
